selection_summary: Selected one coherent lively cafe/friends setting across all slides to keep Aachu's perspective continuous and avoid four unrelated lonely-crowd posters.

slides.exact_on_image_text:
Khaali hai jo tere bina,
main woh ghar hoon tera.

options.description: Lively cafe table with friends around Aachu; an untouched cup sits near her hand, her face stays unsmiling, and the beside-space remains unclaimed.
options.why_it_works: It proves the correction directly: full place, hollow feeling, girl's perspective.
options.risk: Background friends can steal focus if too detailed; identity anchors can also copy the cafe reference pose if not explicitly blocked.

options.description: House party couch with people laughing around Aachu while she sits near the edge of the frame.
options.reason_rejected: Party lighting can become dark/cluttered and hurt text readability.
options.reuse_warning: Use only if cafe feels too quiet.

options.description: Club/bar high table with colored lights and crowd movement behind Aachu.
options.reason_rejected: Too high risk for yellow/purple lighting, identity drift, and quote-card text failure.
options.reuse_warning: Avoid for final unless the creator explicitly wants a club lane.

slides.exact_on_image_text:
Some people don't just enter your life,
they become the place
your heart keeps returning to.

options.description: Same cafe table; Aachu turns slightly toward the entrance or empty beside-space while friends continue talking around her.
options.why_it_works: Her eyeline and body angle physically show the heart returning without using phone-message cliches.
options.risk: Door/entrance must not become too cinematic or shrink her face.

options.description: Aachu at the cafe counter while friends wait behind; she looks past the barista toward the door.
options.reason_rejected: Counter service introduces too many extra figures and weakens the shared-table continuity.
options.reuse_warning: Avoid unless the table composition fails.

options.description: Friends taking a group photo while Aachu's gaze drifts away.
options.reason_rejected: Group-photo staging risks becoming performative and generic.
options.reuse_warning: No phone/camera prop for this iteration.

slides.exact_on_image_text:
Without them,
even the most familiar corners
feel empty.

options.description: Same cafe corner/booth; friends and cups are still present but softened, while Aachu sits at the edge and lightly touches the empty beside-space.
options.why_it_works: It makes the familiar corner public, not domestic, while still proving the emptiness through Aachu's body.
options.risk: Empty chair can become too obvious if it replaces Aachu's expression.

options.description: A crowded cafe restroom mirror moment where Aachu fixes her hair alone between friends.
options.reason_rejected: Mirror staging is fragile for identity and can feel music-video sad instead of lived.

options.description: Aachu standing outside the cafe window looking in at her friends.
options.reason_rejected: It makes her physically excluded from the group, which is simpler and less true than being inside but still lost.
options.reuse_warning: Do not turn emotional loneliness into literal exclusion.

slides.exact_on_image_text:
And with them,
even silence feels safe.

Ghar was never a place.
It was always that one person.

options.description: Same cafe/friends table near the end of the evening; Zuv never appears. Aachu remains beside the unfilled space while the crowd keeps moving around her.
options.why_it_works: It preserves the real impact: no comeback, no resolution, only the realization that a full place still cannot become ghar without him.
options.risk: Must avoid becoming only a sad-girl-in-crowd poster; Aachu's specific body behavior carries the ache.

options.description: Aachu steps outside the cafe alone into a quiet street while friends remain inside.
options.reason_rejected: It removes her from the full place too neatly; the stronger ache is being inside the full place and still not feeling home.
options.reuse_warning: Use only if the cafe-table final becomes visually unreadable.

options.description: Zuv arrives at the entrance and Aachu sees him from across the cafe.
options.reason_rejected: Creator explicitly rejected a comeback payoff because it deceives/weakens the real impact.
options.reuse_warning: Hard reject: no Zuv arrival, no comeback, no reunion.
